# NYC Hearing

> NYC Hearing Associates is a comprehensive audiological practice offering hearing evaluations, hearing aids, cochlear implant services, tinnitus treatment, and auditory rehabilitation across multiple Manhattan locations.

NYC Hearing specializes in professional hearing care with a team of board-certified audiologists (CCC-A, Au.D., FAAA credentials) serving New York City patients. The practice features partnerships with leading hearing device manufacturers including Phonak, Lyric, Starkey, ReSound, Nucleus, and Advanced Bionics, along with specialized services for musicians and personalized concierge care.

## Key Topics

- Hearing aids
- Audiologist services
- Hearing evaluation
- Tinnitus treatment
- Auditory rehabilitation
- Cochlear implants
- Hearing loss treatment
- CCC-A certification
- Au.D. credentials
- Bluetooth hearing technology
- Lyric hearing aids
- Patient care
- Telehealth services
- Musician hearing aids
- Sound therapy
